# Salvatore Di Genua

> Senior Frontend Engineer specializing in Angular, with work across full-stack web applications and AI systems. Based in Montella, Campania, Italy.

## Portfolio

- [English portfolio](https://salvatoredigenua.it/): professional experience, selected projects, AI systems and tools, technical stack, education and contact.
- [Portfolio in italiano](https://salvatoredigenua.it/it/): versione italiana del portfolio.

## Selected work

- [angular-boilerplate](https://github.com/SalvatoreDiGenua/angular-boilerplate): starter for Angular applications with Signals, server-side rendering, hydration and Tailwind CSS.
- [ngx-request-lock](https://github.com/SalvatoreDiGenua/ngx-request-lock-docs): Angular library that coordinates concurrent HTTP requests using Signals, HttpContext and functional interceptors.
- Agentic RAG Platform (in development): document retrieval and source verification for PDFs using Python, LangChain and LangGraph. A preview is available in the portfolio.
